entries.label: PDA
entries.objective: Find who controls lodging/hotel sourcing for PDA TRI Bethesda training; whether Dec 2026+ courses create guestroom demand; Bethesda Marriott eligibility; named buyer/intermediary; listed hotels; practical next action.

namedContacts.name: Laura Keeley
namedContacts.title: Head of Education - Training and Research Institute
namedContacts.relevance: Named TRI education leader; appropriate internal route for course strategy and whether lodging is centrally arranged.

namedContacts.name: Donna Rogers
namedContacts.title: Training Program Manager
namedContacts.relevance: Named TRI training-program contact; appropriate route for course-specific attendee and lodging questions.

namedContacts.name: Tanya Allen
namedContacts.title: Sr. Manager, Logistics
namedContacts.relevance: Named PDA logistics leader; the strongest publicly identifiable internal route for hotel sourcing or room-block escalation, though the public page does not expressly assign her the Bethesda TRI account.

namedContacts.name: Chyanne Vanzant
namedContacts.title: Logistics Coordinator, PDA
namedContacts.relevance: PDA event instructions direct sub-block questions to the PDA Logistics Team at this address; the public professional profile identifies Chyanne Vanzant as PDA's Logistics Coordinator.

namedContacts.name: Training Course Inquiries
namedContacts.title: Functional inbox
namedContacts.relevance: Existing public PDA channel for TRI training-course inquiries; use it to request the current lodging decision-maker and route the hotel proposal.

unresolvedGaps: No public course-level attendee counts or room-night pickup figures.
No public confirmation that PDA has contracted a Bethesda hotel block for the December 2026 courses.
No public confirmation that Bethesda Marriott is eligible, approved, or under consideration as a PDA hotel.
The public staff page identifies logistics personnel but does not assign one person expressly as the Bethesda TRI hotel buyer.
No public evidence establishes whether the three listed hotels have sufficient inventory or whether overflow is currently needed.
structured.bethesdaMarriottFit: Bethesda Marriott is a credible same-city overflow or alternative preferred-hotel prospect for TRI attendees, especially for the multi-day December courses. It is not among the hotels PDA currently lists, and there is no evidence of a Bethesda Marriott booking, block, or partnership. Eligibility should therefore be pursued rather than assumed.
structured.recommendedNextAction: Send a concise hotel-sourcing inquiry to training@pda.org and the PDA Logistics Team at vanzant@pda.org, routing it to Laura Keeley, Donna Rogers, or Tanya Allen as appropriate. Ask: (1) who owns lodging for the December 2026 Bethesda TRI courses; (2) whether an official chosen hotel, sub-block, or overflow plan exists; (3) expected attendee/room needs by course and booking cutoff; and (4) whether Bethesda Marriott may submit a rate and availability proposal. Position Bethesda Marriott as an additional same-city option, not as a current PDA partner or chosen hotel.
structured.timingOrRecurringPattern: Confirmed December 2026 in-person course dates are 1 December, 2–4 December, and 16–17 December at Bethesda TRI. PDA describes TRI as an ongoing facility that trains more than 1,000 attendees annually, but public sources do not provide course-by-course attendance, room pickup, or a guaranteed recurring Bethesda hotel block.
structured.demandOrPartnershipFindings: PDA controls the lodging channel for TRI courses: its Bethesda course pages state that PDA is not affiliated with outside hotel-contracting companies, recommend booking directly through the official PDA-chosen hotel, and identify PDA's Logistics Team as the route for a sub-block. The December 2026 TRI schedule demonstrates real, multi-day in-person demand: Fundamentals of Quality Risk Management is on 1 December, Practical Application of Quality Risk Assessment Tools runs 2–4 December, and Design, Validation, and Operation of Isolator Systems runs 16–17 December, all at 4350 East West Highway, Bethesda. PDA also states that TRI trains more than 1,000 attendees annually, with more than 30% from outside the United States. This supports lodging demand, but no public source confirms room pickup, an existing room block, or a PDA partnership with Bethesda Marriott.

entries.label: CHAMBER
entries.objective: Verify Clarissa Harris role; upcoming/recurring Chamber events that could use hotel catering/meeting space; venue selection patterns; Bethesda Marriott fit; practical outreach step. Do not treat calendar events as uncommitted Marriott demand.

namedContacts.name: Clarissa Harris
namedContacts.title: Vice President, Marketing Communications & Events
namedContacts.relevance: Publicly identified GBCC contact for event planning/details, event sponsorships, and member-hosted events; the practical commercial entry point for venue and catering discussions.

unresolvedGaps: No public evidence confirms Bethesda Marriott is booked, preferred, or partnered with GBCC.
The January 26, 2027 installation reception/annual meeting page does not publish a venue; the 2026 LinkedIn promotion references Hyatt Regency Bethesda, but that does not establish the 2027 venue.
Public sources do not provide attendee counts for each upcoming event, catering budgets, decision deadlines, or whether the Chamber controls venue selection for venue-committed programs.
The 2026 guide's 65+ Off the Clock attendance is a recurring-program statement, not a guaranteed count for any individual date.
structured.bethesdaMarriottFit: A credible same-market option for future uncommitted GBCC receptions, networking happy hours, board or committee meetings, breakfasts, and membership programs. Bethesda Marriott publicly lists 27 event rooms, 18,719 square feet of total event space, a 450-person largest room, smaller rooms such as Pooks Hill with 40 reception/30 banquet capacity and a combined Pooks Hill-Kensington space with 80 reception/60 banquet capacity, plus on-site catering and private dining. This supports a tailored small-to-mid-size reception or day-meeting proposal; guestrooms are optional and no room-night requirement is evidenced.
structured.recommendedNextAction: Email Clarissa Harris with a concise, non-committal venue-sourcing offer: ask which 2027 Off the Clock dates, board/committee meetings, or other member programs remain venue-flexible; propose a 20-minute site tour and two sample packages (65–80-person networking reception and a 30–60-person breakfast/day meeting) at Bethesda Marriott, including appetizer/bar options, signage, registration flow, and a no-room-block assumption. Separately ask whether GBCC wants a 2027 venue/co-sponsor conversation rather than implying any existing booking.
listedCompetitorHotels: Bethesda North Marriott Hotel & Conference Center
structured.timingOrRecurringPattern: Recurring monthly Off the Clock networking is scheduled for the second Tuesday, with 65+ attendees cited in the 2026 sponsorship guide; GBCC also promotes more than 75 annual events and meetings. Near-term calendar markers are the December 15, 2026 Holiday Off the Clock and January 26, 2027 Board Installation Reception / Annual Membership Meeting. Venue commitments already visible for selected 2026 programs indicate that timing alone does not establish Marriott demand.
structured.demandOrPartnershipFindings: Public evidence supports recurring, catering-relevant program demand but not a Bethesda Marriott booking or partnership. GBCC says it hosts more than 75 events and meetings annually; its 2026 guide describes a monthly second-Tuesday Off the Clock networking happy hour, consistently 65+ attendees, complimentary appetizers, an open or cash bar option, and staff assistance securing a venue or co-sponsor. The calendar lists the December 15, 2026 Holiday Off the Clock at Landmark’s Bethesda Row Cinema, with appetizers supplied by hosts and registration closing at capacity. The January 26, 2027 Board Installation Reception and Annual Membership Meeting is listed as an upcoming special event, but no venue is published on the event page. Other published venue commitments show the Legislative Reception at The Bethesdan Hotel (December 1, 2026) and the 100th Anniversary Gala at Bethesda North Marriott Hotel & Conference Center (October 29, 2026); these should not be treated as open Marriott demand.

entries.label: POTOMAC
entries.objective: Verify Carrie Rice role; whether Potomac Events coordinates hotel meetings/guestrooms/banquets/referrals; defensible partnership mechanism for Bethesda Marriott; preferred-venue restrictions; practical partnership introduction. Do not invent an existing partnership.

namedContacts.name: Carrie Rice
namedContacts.title: Founder / Convention Planner (CMP, CIS)
namedContacts.relevance: Relevant commercial entry point for discussing future Bethesda-area meeting, guestroom, banquet, and referral opportunities; current business email was not independently verified.

unresolvedGaps: No independently verified current Potomac Events business email or direct public booking contact for Carrie Rice.
No specific upcoming client, event date, attendee count, guestroom block, banquet spend, or room-night estimate was found.
No public evidence confirms that Potomac Events has referred business to Bethesda Marriott or that Bethesda Marriott has a preferred, exclusive, or contracted relationship with Potomac Events.
Whether Potomac Events is permitted to recommend venues, receives referral compensation, or must follow client/association procurement rules remains unconfirmed.
The public sources establish hotel coordination and event-production capabilities, but do not by themselves prove that Potomac Events controls guestrooms or final venue selection for every client.
structured.bethesdaMarriottFit: Bethesda Marriott is a plausible venue to introduce because its public hotel materials describe guest rooms, meeting space, expert planning and catering at 5151 Pooks Hill Road. Its event page lists 27 event rooms, approximately 18,719 square feet of event space, a largest listed capacity of 450, and multiple breakout, reception, and banquet configurations. That product can match Potomac Events programs requiring one property for sessions, food and beverage, receptions, and attendee lodging. This is fit and partnership potential only—not evidence of a Bethesda Marriott booking or partnership.
structured.recommendedNextAction: Have Bethesda Marriott’s group-sales or event-sales lead send Carrie a short, non-exclusive introduction offering a familiarization/site tour and a current meeting package. Lead with the property’s flexible breakout, banquet, reception, catering, and guestroom capability; ask what Bethesda/Chevy Chase/North Bethesda programs she is currently sourcing, whether clients impose preferred-venue or brand restrictions, how she handles hotel referrals and sourcing fees, and what information she needs to consider Bethesda Marriott. Do not describe the outreach as an existing partnership; position it as a testable referral and preferred-consideration relationship, subject to client choice and any applicable Marriott terms.
structured.timingOrRecurringPattern: No public dated event pipeline, recurring Bethesda program, room-night history, or timing pattern was independently verified.
structured.demandOrPartnershipFindings: Carrie Rice is publicly identified as the founder of Potomac Meetings and Events and as an experienced convention planner/event consultant with CMP and CIS designations. Potomac Events describes work for association and corporate conferences, including hotel-facing timeline coordination, site selection, hotel and vendor negotiations, space-allotment and room-floor-plan assignments, catering and BEO management, receptions, supplier coordination, and onsite event management. This supports a credible planner-intermediary/referral opportunity for hotel meetings, guestrooms, and banquets, but the public evidence does not establish a specific current program, room block, referral fee, booking, or existing relationship with Bethesda Marriott. No public preferred-venue restriction or exclusive hotel arrangement for Potomac Events was found; that should be confirmed directly with Carrie rather than assumed.
